_doc: Numbers the game files do NOT contain. Each entry is used by the engine and is surfaced in the UI/API next to any result that depends on it. Replace a value only with a better-sourced one and update status/source.

rare_mod_count.applies_to: Chaos Orb, Orb of Alchemy, Essences: number of explicit mods on a non-jewel rare
rare_mod_count.source: Long-standing community data-collection results, also the default model used by Craft of Exile. Not published by GGG.

rare_jewel_mod_count.applies_to: Rare jewels / abyss jewels (max 2 prefixes + 2 suffixes)
rare_jewel_mod_count.source: No reliable source found yet. 50/50 placeholder; results depending on it are flagged.

magic_mod_count.applies_to: Orb of Transmutation, Orb of Alteration: 1 or 2 mods on a magic item
magic_mod_count.source: No reliable source found yet. 50/50 placeholder; results depending on it are flagged.
